summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by editing rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext classes, _file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file, and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods), added 19 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, added two docs subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one CHANGELOG.md Added entry linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (837 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing was run: tests, black, and mypy are unverified because the instructions forbade executing repo code. Nothing was committed. Choices: cast() on the mode argument so the module-level open can call the overloaded Progress.open, and ContextManager[Any] as the implementation return type so no return-value or type-variable suppressions were needed.
